title.narrative: Output A.1: Regulation on Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) encompassing Circular Economy is developed and approved.

Output A.1 indicator: - An EPR-working group established including participants from the private sector and government institutions. - 6 quarterly EPR working group meetings held. - Minimum two workshops conducted for the EPR working group. - The EPR working group has shared written input with Kenyan government partners.

target.value: An EPR-working group established, working group meetings and workshop held, and written input with Kenyan government partners shared.

actual.value: Achieved. The results will be reported upon under the new Framework agreement

target.value: An EPR-working group established, working group meetings and workshop held, and written input with Kenyan government partners shared.

actual.value: Partly achieved. The regulation on EPR is almost through the legislative process. The new Kenyan Minister of En-vironment and Forestry promised 20 February that the regulation would be adopted within 2 months at the latest (first half of 2023). A specific working group under SSC has not been neces-sary to establish, as the MoEF already has established a stakeholder consultation group for the de-velopment of the EPR regulation. SSC has been engaging regularly with this group instead

target.value: An EPR-working group established, working group meetings and workshop held, and written input with Kenyan government partners shared.

actual.value: The results will be reported upon under the new Framework agreement

title.narrative: Output A.2: Guidelines on the regulations on Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) developed and approved

Output A.2 indicator: - Minimum two workshops conducted for the working group. - Guidelines addressing roles and responsibilities for producers and PROs within the EPR scheme drafted and approved by the EPR working group. - Guidelines on specific product categories in the EPR scheme drafted and approved by the EPR working group. - The two guidelines are shared with Kenyan government partners.

target.value: Workshops conducted, guidelines drafted and approved, and shared with Kenyan government partners

actual.value: Achieved. The results will be reported upon under the new Framework agreement

target.value: Workshops conducted, guidelines drafted and approved, and shared with Kenyan government partners

actual.value: Partæy achieved. Development of guideline document has begun and is going according to plan. The guideline doc-ument is expected to be completed in July 2023. Stakeholder involvement is planned through online consultations and 2 workshops in Nairobi, but a working group has proven not necessary to establish after all, as the MoEF already has a stake-holder consulting group in place.

target.value: Workshops conducted, guidelines drafted and approved, and shared with Kenyan government partners

actual.value: The results will be reported upon under the new Framework agreement
